summary: Re-verified at b95097e (SubagentStop early settle). handedBack review: it returns true only when the transcript's last line is a user tool_result whose tool_use_id equals a SubagentHandback tool_use in the 64 KB tail; Claude Code writes that result after the hand-back assistant line (which carries the final usage), so the answer and last tokens are already in the file; a tail it cannot parse, a hand-back too big for the tail, or an agent that never hands back falls to the old 150 ms quiet wait, so failures are slow, not lossy. Live 3 of 3: result and tokens exact, SubagentStop 79-94 ms. Mutations of handedBack: always-true went red in the builder test only, ignoring the id match survived everything; I added a verify test (id mismatch and a hand-back appended 120 ms late through the real hook) that turns both red. Doubts: the early exit is exercised live only under --permission-mode auto (the SubagentHandback tool exists only in auto mode on 2.1.314); hand-back not exercised when the hand-back assistant line is split across several lines of one message; live is headless, not the v2 project.
